svg.title: Lapse and shift separate two choices
svg.desc: A diagonal coordinate-time step is decomposed into a normal step between slices and a tangential shift. Lapse controls normal proper-time separation; shift controls the tangential relabeling. Arrow lengths are schematic and do not represent an ordinary Euclidean decomposition of a Lorentzian norm.

g.text: 33 / LAPSE AND SHIFT SEPARATE TWO CHOICES
A coordinate step between spatial slices
The split is bookkeeping, not a preferred cosmic clock.

svg.data-tex: \text{Spatial metric }\gamma\text{: rulers within a slice. Extrinsic curvature }K\text{: how it sits in spacetime.}
svg.aria-label: Spatial metric γ: measurements within a slice. Extrinsic curvature K: how that slice sits in spacetime.
